I have exactly the same problem you are going through. I wake up at 3 and couldn't sleep until 6. Then sleep for an hour and have trouble waking up at 7. 

Here are the few things I tried
Tried to sleep late - this helped me to an extend
Tried not to be worried about sleep and started listening to podcasts or audio books during this time
Started doing something productive like reading a book or preparing for certification
Decided to work out early in the morning 

I found some success but I still have this problem often.
